verdict.rationale: Morph's docs tell developers to point any OpenAI SDK at https://api.morphllm.com/v1 with one API key, and say existing OpenAI code needs only a new model string (the llms.txt probe also lists the base URL as OpenAI-compatible). A community user independently confirms getting it working through the OpenAI-compatible endpoint with their own CLI tool. missing for 10: a documented compatibility matrix of supported OpenAI endpoints and parameters (e.g. streaming, tool calling), and an end-to-end SDK code example in the evidence.
